name: zerocool-publish-tools
description: npm, hash pinned. The npm node bundles is whatever node shipped that day; npm 10 carried fixed CVEs in its bundled deps and is too old for trusted publishing (npm >= 11.5.1). Both agent images replace the bundled npm with this one, and release-please.yml installs it with npm ci. npm 12.0.2 ships older tar, undici, ip-address and brace-expansion than 11.19.1, so the pin stays on 11 until a 12.x carries the fixes.
